messages:
sam: Heads-up: embargo lift set for Tue 2026-06-02 08:00 PT. Blog + benchmark assets go live then. Need final approvals and monitoring plan by EOD today. @elaine @ash
maya: Working through copy edits now. Legal flagged a performance claim line \"2x cost reduction\" 1: should we hedge?
ash: Legal prefers: 'up to 2x on select workloads' or cite the methodology. Also require a stats appendix link.
elaine: I'll finalize the press list. Adding one more EU tech outlet. Also prepping a short quote from CTO - need approval from product.
diego: Social assets ready except GIF. GIF from infra demo is 3.8MB, loop <5s. Ready to schedule. What timezone scheduling strategy?
robin: Schedule main tweet at 08:00 PT, then follow-ups at 09:00 PT and 12:00 PT. EU post at 16:00 UTC. I'll handle posting automation.
press_bot: Embargo record updated: key=redwood-bench-june-02. Outreach window 08:00-08:20 PT. Contacts queued: 24.
ash: Quick marketing policy note: do not share customer-specific benchmarks or named customers without CS signoff.
maya: Draft social captions use hedged claim per legal. Shortlist included. I'll drop them in #marketing-drafts for copycheck.
sam: Who's on monitoring first 3 hours? expect spikes. Need someone hour 0-1, 1-2, 2-3.
diego: I can take 0-1 and triage any repo mentions. Robin can take 1-2?
robin: Yep taking 1-2, will escalate to ops on regressions.
elaine: Press email drafted. Reply-to set to press@redwood.ai. Including methodology appendix: https://redwood.ai/meth-jun02
press_bot: Outreach sent to Tier 1 at 2026-06-02T15:00:05Z (09:00 PT). Monitoring hooks enabled: social, press, zendesk.
ash: Reminder: embargo violations escalate to PR lead + legal. React with :white_check_mark: after you confirm assets are final.
maya: :white_check_mark: Assets uploaded to Shared Drive > Marketing/JuneBenchLaunch.
sam: Final: maintain neutral phrasing, link to methodology, and CS-only roster stays internal. Thanks everyone. Closing thread once launch is confirmed live.
